rules:
CARDS: Ranks {min_rank} to {max_rank}, {copies_per_rank} copies of each, plus {clear_cards} Clear cards written 'C'. Low = 1-{low_band_max}, Mid = {mid_band_min}-{mid_band_max}, High = {high_band_min}-{max_rank}.

SETUP: Each seat is dealt {cards_per_band_dealt} random low, {cards_per_band_dealt} mid and {cards_per_band_dealt} high cards plus {clears_per_seat} C: {hand_size} cards, kept private. Then {face_up_picks} face-up picks are made, all seats choosing at the same time: each pick moves one card of your choice (options are the ranks in your hand ascending, then C last) from your hand to your public up_pile. A missing or invalid pick takes the first listed card. You then hold {hand_after_picks} in hand and {face_up_picks} face up.

ROUNDS: Each round the lead moves one seat: round 1 is led by seat 1, round 2 by seat 2, round 3 by seat 3, round 4 by seat 1, and so on. Seats play in order lead, lead+1, lead+2 (seat 3 wraps to seat 1).

A TURN: You play from your hand while it has cards; once your hand is empty you play from your up_pile. Your options: for each rank r you hold with r at least the pile's top rank (top rank {empty_top_rank} means empty, so anything goes), 'r xk' for k from 1 up to the copies of r you hold, listed by rank then k; then 'C' last if you hold a C (always legal). If you have none of these, your only option is 'take'. A missing or invalid answer plays the first listed option.
- 'r xk': the k cards go on the pile. If the top rank was already r, the run grows by k; otherwise the run becomes k. The top rank becomes r.
- 'C': the C and the whole pile are removed from the game; top rank and run reset to 0.
- 'take': every pile card goes into your hand; top rank and run reset to 0.
If the run reaches {run_to_clear} or more, the whole pile is removed from the game and top rank and run reset to 0; if it does not, the pile stays. After your turn, cards_left = cards in hand + cards in up_pile. All plays are announced; hands stay private. There is no talk.

WINNING: The first seat whose cards_left reaches 0 ends the game at once (remaining turns are skipped) and wins. If {max_rounds} rounds pass with nobody at 0, the seat with the fewest cards_left wins; seats tied for fewest share the result (a draw).
